Evidence types span profiled software simulations and benchtop hardware testbeds without flight-network validation: R0048 evaluates Python/PyTorch simulations parameterized with measured Raspberry Pi 3B+ and NCS1/NCS2 profiles, whereas R0062 evaluates a physical 4-UAV hardware testbed (3 Jetson Nano + 1 Jetson TX2 with airborne communication modules) that P09 D07 rates PARTIAL because actual flight-network and 3D mobility validation are absent.
